pbq-5-004.prompt: Classify each security awareness activity by the program objective it most directly supports.
pbq-5-004.context: Tap an activity, then tap the objective bucket where it belongs. Each activity goes into exactly one bucket; one bucket is a distractor that no activity belongs in.

items.text: Verify a sender's identity before sharing credentials
Report suspicious email to the security team immediately
Escalate a suspected insider-threat indicator to the help desk
Review clean-desk and removable-media guidance during onboarding

pbq-5-004.hint: Think about what each activity changes in employee behavior: resisting attacks, reporting incidents, or building knowledge over time.
pbq-5-004.explanation: Simulated campaigns and identity-verification drills strengthen resistance to phishing and social engineering (b1). Reporting suspicious messages and escalating insider-threat indicators feed the organization's detection loop (b2). Annual role-based training and onboarding guidance build sustained awareness (b3). Vulnerability scanning is a technical control, not an awareness activity, so no item belongs in that bucket.

sourceRefs.section: Objective 5.6 — Given a scenario, implement security awareness practices
